aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 10.2.2.1 and 10.2.2.2 source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_107.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 213 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. Only 5 of the 32 scoped base units are newly accounted, because 27 numbered items, R1034 through R1041 and C1016 through C1034, were already accounted by the numbered-rule inventory; the reviewer verified all 27 individually with no double count and no dropped unit. 92 new facets remain pending. The zero-permissions verdict was independently adjudicated: the words may, need not, is permitted to and processor dependent do not occur in this scope at all, and the two occurrences of can are a second semantic route for pointer assignment through a derived-type intrinsic assignment statement and an informative NOTE describing an admitted program shape. 10.2.2.2 p1 and p2 are correctly definitions rather than requirements, stating what data-pointer-object, proc-pointer-object, data-target and proc-target denote, and no normative obligation was lost. The 32-row attribution table was audited rather than accepted, with every constraint yielding two or more negatives examined to confirm each is individually attributable to a single prohibiting clause. Pointer-specific discipline was verified: no plan reads, compares, dereferences, invokes or inquires about a pointer whose association status is undefined, since such a program is not conforming; ASSOCIATED is proposed only after another cited source establishes defined status, with 16.9.20 retained as an explicit dependency so the oracle is not circular; and no bounds oracle is asserted without nondefault bounds. Detailed data-pointer and procedure-pointer assignment effects are not registered here and belong to 10.2.2.3 and 10.2.2.4. No pointer assignment execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
